headline.en: Preference Density Alignment for Conversational Audio EQ
headline.zh: 偏好密度对齐用于对话式音频均衡

summary.en: This week adds one paper on aligning a language model for conversational audio equalization using preference density maps from roughly 90,000 user samples, evaluated with a blind listening test against a GPT-4o mini baseline. No verified source projects were added.
summary.zh: 本周新增一篇论文，利用约9万条用户样本构建偏好密度图来对齐语言模型，实现对话式音频均衡，并通过盲听测试与 GPT-4o mini 基线对比验证。本周没有新增经核实的源码项目。

note.en: It aligns a language model to listener preferences with non-parametric density maps built from about 90,000 user samples, then checks the result in a blind equalization listening test against a GPT-4o mini baseline.
note.zh: 该方法用约9万条用户样本构建非参数偏好密度图，将语言模型对齐到听者偏好，并通过盲听均衡测试与 GPT-4o mini 基线进行对比。
